title: Vagina
summary: The vagina is the muscular, stretchy canal that connects the vulva to the cervix and uterus. Menstrual blood leaves the body through it and it is the birth canal.
key_points: It is self-cleaning; normal discharge keeps it healthy.
It expands and lubricates with arousal.
Douching or scented products can upset its natural balance.
